text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ouch... Letting my mind drift during<n>practice wasn't
my smartest move. I<n>need to focus on what's
happening<n>in front of me.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I won't be doing that again. All right,<n>back to
training.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ow!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I can't say it doesn't... But this is<n>nothing compared
to the injury I<n>suffered when I was little.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure it'll be fine once we wrap it<n>up. Now, let's
not waste any more<n>time.
choice_data_list: You need to take a break.

I'll stop you if it looks like you're pushing yourself,
okay?

I'll stop you if it looks like you're pushing yourself,
okay?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure it'll be fine once we wrap it<n>up. Now, let's
not waste any more<n>time.
choice_data_list: You need to take a break.

I'll stop you if it looks like you're pushing yourself,
okay?

I'll stop you if it looks like you're pushing yourself,
okay?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
But my rivals will get even farther<n>ahead if I don't
keep practicing.
choice_data_list:
And you think keeping up with them is worth risking
a major injury?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Well, I... I...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I guess I can't argue with that.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If I continue practicing while injured,<n>it's far more
likely that I'll seriously<n>hurt myself and be forced to
lose<n>even more progress...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Yet despite understanding thatlogically, I just can't... Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry... I'll do as you say and<n>take a break.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: That's fine by me!

I treat her injury with some basic first<n>aid and keep
a close eye on her<n>condition.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Phew... It feels a lot better. Thank you.<n>Shall we
head to the track?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ow...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The area around the injury is getting<n>a little swollen,
but it's all right. I just<n>need some painkillers, and
I'll be—
choice_data_list: No. No more running. You promised, remember?
No. No more running. You promised, remember?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: B-but!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Urgh... That disapproving glare of<n>yours hurts me far
more than my<n>actual injury.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Fine... I'll go get it looked at.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It feels fine when I run on it. I should<n>be able to
keep training.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I won't. I know it's still not fully<n>healed, and I don't
want it to get<n>worse, so I'll be careful.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You've always believed in me... and<n>met my
demands accordingly. Now<n>it's my turn to heed
your advice.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Okay! I'll start with about ten percent<n>of my
strength and see how I fare.

Training goes just fine, and her<n>injury heals with
no problems!
